meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用约束模型计算代谢网络通量,预测基因敲除带来的影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用约束模型研究代谢网络、做通量或基因敲除分析。
copy.tagline_en: Model metabolic networks to compute fluxes and predict gene knockout effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study metabolic networks with constraint-based models.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Python 的 cobrapy 载入、搭建或导出代谢模型,跑 FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样等计算,并给出通量数值、生长速率和结果表。
howto.when: 当你要求载入或导出 SBML 等模型文件,或跑 FBA、基因敲除等分析时,这个技能会接管。

say.text: 载入 textbook 模型跑一次 FBA,告诉我生长速率
say.note: 返回目标值与各反应通量

say.text: 对这个模型做单基因敲除,找出必需基因
say.note: 输出敲除后的生长结果表

say.text: 把葡萄糖摄取设成 10、氧气设成 0,再看生长

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude loads, builds or exports metabolic models through cobrapy's Python API, runs FBA, FVA, gene knockouts and flux sampling, and returns flux values, growth rates and result tables.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to load or export SBML model files, or to run FBA, gene knockouts and similar analyses.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model, run FBA and report the growth rate.
Run single gene deletions on this model and list essential genes.
Set glucose uptake to 10 and oxygen to 0, then check growth.
